title: design: capture preview card (NIW2-606)
body:
Refs [NIW2-606](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-606)

## Summary

Design only, no code. After a screenshot, Kaipu stays out of the way: **Capture and Copy both end in an image-first floating card** at the top-right of the display, instead of Capture opening the editor.

- The card is the existing capture toast window (`CaptureToastWindow`), redrawn: the screenshot fills it.
- At rest it shows **Saved ✓** and **Copied · ⌘V** on the image.
- On hover: accent border, the image dims, **Edit** (pencil) in the middle, **✕** in the corner, and the states become buttons — Saved reveals the file, Copy copies (and reads Copied ✓).
- The editor opens only from Edit or a click on the image. A shot that landed nowhere still opens the editor.

## What this PR adds

- Spec: `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-11-02-capture-preview-card-design.md` (decisions table, failures, acceptance criteria).
- **ADR 0042** — Capture and Copy both end in the preview card. Supersedes decision 4 of ADR 0024 and reverses the 2026-10-20 capture-flow fix; 0024's status row and `backlog/capture-flow-fixes.md` point to it.
- Mockup: `apps/documentation/public/mockups/capture-preview.html` — illustrative, hand-written with the app's tokens; the first card reacts to a real hover.

Out of scope on purpose: the main window coming back above the frontmost app after a capture. The owner tests the card first.

## Checks

- `bun run build` in `apps/documentation`: passes, both new pages built.
- `oxfmt` run on every changed file.

## How to test it yourself

1. `bun run dev` in `apps/documentation` (or open the file directly in a browser).
2. Open `/mockups/capture-preview.html`. Hover the first card: border turns pink, the image dims, Edit and ✕ appear, the bar at the bottom stops draining. Move off: it drains again.
3. Open `/specs/2026-11-02-capture-preview-card-design/` and check the decisions table matches what you asked for (11 rows).
4. Open `/architecture/decisions/0042-capture-ends-in-the-preview-card/`, then ADR 0024: its "Superseded by" row now links 0042.
